description: Say on the person's setup screen what you are doing now, in one short English line ("Reading the Menu page", "Wiring the About page", "Building the site"): they watch the setup there, not this conversation. Call it as each step starts; a line within 2 seconds of the last one is dropped (kept: false), never refused. Never put a key, token or secret in it.

page.description: The page the line is about, as the page map names it.
